verified: Tom's Hardware reports the substrate market shares for Sumitomo Electric, AXT and JX Advanced Metals, China's roughly 70% share of refined indium, and the Chinese export-licensing requirement on AXT's substrate output; it also quotes Lumentum's CEO on fabs running more than 30% below demand and Coherent describing InP capacity as its primary constraint, both company statements.
unconfirmed: no independent measurement of the size of the shortfall is given — the demand gap rests on the two vendors' own characterisations — and the report offers no timeline for when new InP capacity or newly qualified suppliers will reach volume, nor the detailed terms behind Nvidia's stated $2 billion investment in each company.

verified: Tom's Hardware 的报道确认了 InP 衬底产能集中度（住友电工与 AXT 合计近 80%、JX 约 10%）、AXT 中国产线需出口许可，以及英伟达对 Lumentum 和 Coherent 各 20 亿美元的投资。
unconfirmed: 短缺的量化规模与持续时间、英伟达投资所附采购承诺和产能权利的具体条款均未披露；Lumentum 的 30% 出货缺口和 Coherent 的“首要约束”说法来自公司高管，未经独立核实。
